items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: He hooked on with Ray Miller, Black and White Melody Boys.

ctx.x: were you in the vaudeville thing for the musical rubes? Yeah. Yeah, we played, uh, oh, I guess it must

have been about a month at, uh, six weeks at the absolute most. They brought us from one end of New York. Was it a chain of, uh, a picture of shows? Yeah, the theater's own. They brought us from the north end to the south end and the crossover into Brooklyn and down in, uh, Long Island and everywhere. We were playing all the houses you never heard of. And the closest we ever got to the Ballad Theater was, we played one of those Sunday concerts. They used to have Sunday concerts in New York at that time, you know,…
No head. But what year do you think that was? About 1915? No, that was 16. Yeah. Then,
